phase_name: Authority Evaluation Integration Final Operational Readiness and Chapter Certification
summary: Final operational readiness assessment and chapter certification for the complete Authority Evaluation Integration chapter (147A-147O.2) against AESIC-001 v1.3. Did not inherit any predecessor's conclusions uncritically: independently re-read the full 2,930-line contract, re-walked the production call chain (decision-session confirm/readiness -> governance-record publish -> CHGR) directly against current source (decision_session.py, session_service.py, aesic/composition.py, aesic/service.py, aesic/storage.py, governance/publication/coordinator.py, governance/publication/record.py), and empirically reproduced the two carried-forward findings' exact mechanics rather than re-citing prior reports. Confirmed AESIC-O-01 remains closed: single composition root at decision_session.py:221, unchanged since 147O.1. Independently re-derived AESIC-N-01 (canonical pointer cross-key confusion in read_canonical/read_record, storage.py:166-197) as Major but contained: zero production write-path or CLI-write reachability, confirmed by a fresh call-graph walk, not by trusting 147N/147O/147O.2's own description. Independently re-derived and empirically reproduced 147O.2-F-1 (package_id='..' breaks single-level path containment because _safe_name's regex admits '.') as Minor and contained: reachable only via the read-only 'pcae aesic status --package-id' diagnostic, escapes at most one directory level, never leaves .pcae/authority-evaluation/records/. Recorded one Informational clarification (147O.3-I-1): the non-gating guarantee (AESIC-REQ-091) governs the AES evaluation outcome value only -- a Stage 2 technical/infrastructure failure legitimately and intentionally blocks readiness package construction (retryable, by contract design), distinct from outcome-based gating, already correctly if implicitly disclosed by 147O.1/147O.2. Also independently reconfirmed: non-gating semantics end-to-end (Publication Coordinator carries zero Authority Evaluation references, confirmed by direct source inspection), CHGR citation-only integration (record.py:266-277 reads only citation_text, never evaluation_result), backward compatibility (build_authority_evaluation_service() returns None in this repository today, reproduced live via pcae aesic status), runtime preservation (pcae runtime inspect: Observed / observe / unavailable, unchanged; zero commits since 147J touch any runtime-concept file, confirmed via direct diff/log check), restart/recovery/concurrency characteristics (unchanged from 147N/147O.2, confirmed via a diff-emptiness check finding zero src/pcae/**/tests/** changes since 147O.2), and .pcae/policy.toml's aesic/interactive_workflow/commands zone edges match real imports exactly. A second, independently-delegated verification pass (separate context) covering the same seven highest-risk claims converged on the same conclusions, surfacing the 147O.3-I-1 clarification. Also retroactively added '## Phase 147O Complete'/'## Phase 147O.1 Complete'/'## Phase 147O.2 Complete' sections to PROJECT_STATUS.md, which had never been added by those phases (PROJECT_STATUS.md's 'Current Phase' section had stayed on 147O's own text through both 147O.1 and 147O.2 despite both being fully recorded in CHANGELOG.md, git history, and .pcae/ metadata) -- judged an in-scope ordinary status/finalization artifact fix, not a substantive change. No new Blocking or Major finding discovered. Operational Readiness Verdict: AUTHORITY EVALUATION INTEGRATION OPERATIONALLY READY WITH OBSERVATIONS. Chapter Certification Verdict: AUTHORITY EVALUATION INTEGRATION CHAPTER CERTIFIED WITH OBSERVATIONS.
